_note: The TRAINING GROUP's moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: partner (the close training partners, data/cast.json partners) or partner:<role> (joker, racer, veteran, newcomer, quiet, leader, talker: coaching.json club.group.roles), teammate (anyone in the coach's group). They change with the coach (a new group comes with a new coach). Moments never change what is trained: a reply moves moods, the relationship or a remembered flag. Ages 14-16 (P2 adds 16-17). All teammates are fictional.

text: Hey, you're the new one in {coach_first}'s group, right? I'm {from}. Want to warm up together on Thursday?
Welcome to the group! Tip: never stand next to {coach_first} while the reps are being counted. You'll get an extra one.

replies.label: Sure, Thursday!
replies.result: Cool. I'm the one with the orange hat.

text: Intervals today. I've already written my will. You can have my spikes.
Rumour: {coach_first} is adding two reps because it's Tuesday. Or Wednesday. Any day really.
I dreamt the intervals were cancelled. Then I woke up.

replies.label: Ha! See you there
replies.result: If I faint, carry me to the café.

text: -17 this morning. My eyelashes froze. Are we really running outside?
The weather app says 'stay indoors'. {coach_first} says 'tights and a buff'.

replies.label: Real runners love winter
replies.result: You are not normal. See you there.

replies.label: I hate this country
replies.result: Ha! Same. Three layers, see you at five.

text: I beat you on the last rep today. Just saying.
Last 200 today: me 31.8, you 32.4. I wrote it down.
You were slower on reps 4-6. I noticed. Tired?
Score so far: me 7, you 4. Last reps only. Don't pretend you're not counting.
OK, you won the last rep today. It doesn't count, I had a stitch.
First big meet? At my first Nuorten SM I threw up in the call room. Then I ran a PB. So, you know.
Advice for {meet}: warm up early, don't watch the other heats, and eat something an hour before.

replies.label: Thanks, that helps
replies.result: You'll be fine. Probably no throwing up.

replies.label: What else should I know?
replies.result: Bring two pairs of socks. Long story.

text: You were limping a bit today. Tell {coach_first}. I didn't, at your age, and lost a whole summer.
Sore shins? That's how my stress fracture started. Don't be a hero.
Sorry to bother you. How do you do the A-skip? I always look like a broken giraffe.
Is it normal to be this tired after an 'easy' run? Asking for me.
What do I wear for winter training? My mum bought me a ski jacket.
I ran my first race without dying! Your tips helped. Thank you!
{coach_first} said my drills look better. I told him you taught me.

replies.label: I'm proud of you!
replies.result: You're like a big sibling. A fast one.

text: Long run tomorrow? Same pace as last time. I don't talk much, you know that.
Tomorrow's long run. Forest loop? Quiet is good.
Tomorrow's reps: I'll lead the first half, you take the second. Deal?
Let's run tomorrow's session together. I'll set the pace, you just hang on.
Did you hear? {teammate} might switch to the 400. And {coach_first} was on the phone forever after practice. Something's going on.
OMG, {teammate} got new spikes, the bright green ones. They cost like a phone.
Don't tell anyone, but I think {coach_first} is getting a new group from the other club.

replies.label: Tell me everything
replies.result: OK, so. It started on Tuesday...

text: My mum is driving to {meet}. There's room for one more. Want a ride?
Going to {meet} by car, leaving early. Seat's free if you want it.

replies.label: Yes please!
replies.result: Pick-up at seven. Bring the playlist.

replies.label: My family is driving me
replies.result: See you in the call room then.

text: PB!! I saw the results. {coach_first} was smiling, which is rare.
{pb}! Now I have to train harder. Thanks a lot.

replies.label: The group made me faster
replies.result: Aww. Don't get soft on us.

text: Rough one today. Happens to everyone. I DNF'd at my first indoor race.
Don't look at the time too long. Tomorrow we're running anyway.
Group chat poll: best post-session snack? Pulla, banana or chocolate milk?
Who left a single spike shoe in the changing room? It smells like a crime.
Saturday after the long run: café? The one with the big cinnamon buns.

replies.label: Chocolate milk
replies.result: Recovery science agrees with you. Apparently.

text: Can I tell you something? I'm thinking of quitting. School is too much, and I'm not getting faster.
I don't enjoy it any more. Maybe I'll stop after this season.

replies.label: Talk to {coach_first}
replies.result: Yeah. Maybe a lighter plan would help.

text: Bad news: stress fracture. Six weeks off. I'm going crazy already.
I rolled my ankle on the trail. Crutches for a week. Will you tell me what we did in practice?

replies.label: I'll keep you updated
replies.result: Thanks. Send pictures of the suffering.

text: Kalevan kisat this weekend! The men's 800 final is on Sunday. Watch it together at the clubhouse?
The national champs on TV! Group viewing at my place, the 800 m finals. Bring snacks.

replies.label: Yes!
replies.result: Someday that's us on the screen.

replies.label: I'll watch at home
replies.result: Live chat during the final then.

text: Ruotsi-ottelu this weekend! Finland against Sweden. The whole club is watching in the clubhouse.
Finnkampen! We HAVE to beat Sweden this year. Watching?

replies.label: Hyvä Suomi!
replies.result: Blue and white face paint, compulsory.

text: Base training again. Long runs, hills, and darkness at five. Ready?
New season, new us. This year I'm going under 2:10. Write it down.

replies.label: My goal is bigger
replies.result: Oh really? Tell me in the spring.

text: It's my birthday on Thursday. I'm bringing cake to practice. Don't tell {coach_first}, or we'll all be running it off.
Birthday cake after Saturday's session, my mum made it. You coming?

replies.label: I'll bring something too
replies.result: You don't have to! But OK, yes.

text: Have you seen the Pajulahti camps for 7-9 graders? A whole week with real coaches. My parents say it's expensive.
I heard the TF-juniorit camp people come to the big meets to watch. Imagine getting picked.

replies.label: Let's just train well
replies.result: True. One week at a time.

text: Dark at three o'clock. Headlamps tonight, and stay on the lit trail, OK?
I can't remember the last time I saw the sun after school. Running in the dark again.

replies.label: Let's run together
replies.result: Two headlamps are better than one.

text: Indoor season! The hall smells of rubber and nerves. Who's racing first?
The indoor bends are so tight. My elbows are ready.

replies.label: The bends scare me
replies.result: Stay on the inside of lane one and you're fine.

text: Those hills today. My calves are writing a complaint.
Eight hill reps and I could only feel my legs on the first four.
Which spikes do you have? Mine are falling apart and I don't want to spend a fortune.
I bought new spikes and they feel like walking on nails. Is that normal at first?
Did you SEE that moose on the long run?! It just stood there looking at us.
Long run today and a deer ran across the path right in front of me. My heart rate is still up.

replies.label: I thought we were done for
replies.result: Best tempo of the year, though. Moose motivation.

replies.label: I missed it!
replies.result: Next time, look up from your watch.

text: The club needs a relay team for the district meet. 4 × 400. We need you as the fourth. In?
Relay at the club meet next month! The coach said it's up to us who runs. You?

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: Team! We'll practise the changeovers on Thursday.

text: It's {coach_first}'s birthday on Thursday! We're getting a card and a cake. Will you chip in two euros?
Secret: we're singing for {coach_first} after the session on Thursday. Birthday. Are you in?

replies.label: Of course
replies.result: The coach went red and pretended to be annoyed. Everyone saw the smile.
